title: Concept: Secret passed as a build argument via ARG DB_PASSWORD (dockerfile) — review required
description: In a Dockerfile, ARG DB_PASSWORD declares a build argument whose name marks it as a credential. Values supplied to build arguments appear in image build metadata and can persist in cached layers, and any user who can trigger a rebuild can read them. Use a BuildKit secret mount and keep the value out of layers (a BuildKit secret mount).
applicability: Dockerfiles and container build definitions; lexical scope.
risk: Credential disclosure through image metadata and caches; MEDIUM severity.
